mx1-single-native.title: Millennium Park — single still native test
mx1-single-native.summary: One Chicago still. Silent native singles: Instagram Single Image, Facebook Single Image, TikTok Single Photo. No voiceover, no music. AI thumbnail required for the grid.

mx2-single-reel.title: Chicago Riverwalk — single reel with voice and music
mx2-single-reel.summary: One Chicago still rendered as video with voiceover and music: Instagram Reel, Facebook Reel, TikTok Video Draft, YouTube Short. AI thumbnail required for the grid.

mx3-multi-slideshow.title: Downtown Chicago — multi still slideshow with voice
mx3-multi-slideshow.summary: Three Chicago stills with voiceover and music: Instagram Reel, Facebook Slideshow Reel, TikTok Video Draft, YouTube Slideshow Video. AI thumbnail required for the grid.

mx4-stories-plus-feed.title: Lakefront — stories plus native feed stills
mx4-stories-plus-feed.summary: One Chicago still. Silent native feed singles plus Instagram Story and Facebook Story extras. AI thumbnail required on feed posts that appear on the grid. Stories are not grid covers.

mx5-youtube-standard.title: Chicago skyline — YouTube standard 16x9 with voice
mx5-youtube-standard.summary: One Chicago still with voiceover and music aimed at YouTube Standard Video 16:9 plus an Instagram Reel. AI thumbnail required for the grid and YouTube.
